description: AegisSat develops the Space Mission Architecture Simulator for Space Mission Design Game. Backed by TRL-7 flight heritage (KÜPSAT-01, 25.64km apogee, TPMK 2025/007159) & IAC 2026 study (IAC-26-C2.IPB.29, AA7075-T6/CFRP/Rigid 10K), we pair radiation shielding with WERR 24-Byte 0-SRAM FNS avionics & Negative Schwarzian/Koenigs ADCS. Stress-test CubeSats against NASA SPENVIS/OMNIWeb solar storms & SEU bit-flips. Live: https://aegissat.space | Code: https://github.com/bdagli-web/aegissat
